Hi Sean / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. We're preparing a partner announcement for our new interoperability feature (tentative press date Nov 18) and would like to include Redwood as a named partner and use your logo in a co-branded banner on our launch microsite.

Attached is our draft press release and a short list of where the logo will appear (homepage banner, partner page, announcement tweet). Procurement also asked I route an order form and MSA redline to your team so we can get legal cleared. They'll expect a 3-business-day SLA for marketing approvals from both sides.

Specific asks:
- Permission to use the Redwood wordmark + logo on the launch page and partner list
- A short customer quote from our product team (we can share copy for approval)
- Confirmation we can name Greenline as a reference later (case study) with a 6-month embargo on the public case study until the partnership milestones are reached

I attached the draft PR and the procurement note. Can you confirm what approvals you need and the expected timeline?

Best,
Eleanor

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Draft launch + logo usage request

Team — forwarding Greenline's request. Key points from procurement: MSA + order form redlines attached. External wants a 3-business-day SLA for marketing approvals; procurement will chase DocuSign once legal signs off.

Quick thoughts (legal/ops ask):
- We should avoid a blanket "reference rights" clause. Propose: non-exclusive, non-transferable permission to use name/logo for the specific launch assets listed, with mutual sign-off required for any additional use (e.g., case study, press tour).
- Logo files: limit to three assets (homepage banner, partner page, announcement social card). No use in paid ads without separate approval.
- Quote usage: allow an anonymized technical quote (unless they provide signed approvable quote). Approvals to be completed within 48 business hours (2 business days) once copy is provided to our comms team — shorter than their 3-day request to reduce blocking.
- Embargo: we can accept a 6-month case study embargo, but we need explicit milestone language: case study release only after X integration milestones or mutual marketing approval.
- Carveouts: request a narrow confidentiality carveout that allows mention of the partnership for security/compliance attestations (SOC2 letter) but nothing more.

I'm attaching a redline of the MSA focusing on publicity/reference sections (MSA_v3_redlines.pdf). Marissa — can you own comms approval timeline? Ben — can you confirm that limited logo permission is ok from partnership side? Kimberly — can you quick-review the redline and call out any legal showstoppers?

Thanks,
Sean
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (pdf)

Eleanor — thanks for the materials, this looks great. Quick operational proposal to speed approval:

- We can greenlight the three asset uses you listed. I'll send final logo files and brand guidelines once legal confirms the narrow usage language.
- For quote copy, if you share the suggested line by EOD Thursday (your time), we'll aim to turn approval within 24–48 hours.
- We prefer a mutual sign-off for any case study; 6-month embargo is fine but please include milestone criteria (e.g., production integration complete + joint announcement).

If procurement needs redlines on order form terms (payment, PO number), please cc procurement@ — we'll get finance involved.

On the legal side: I'm fine with the 48 business-hour SLA Sean proposed if legal agrees. That should keep the launch schedule on track.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — that timeline works for us. Procurement flagged two items they need before DocuSign:

We can accept a 48-hour marketing approval SLA if legal agrees to the limited usage + milestone language. Please advise on the COI and subcontract list — my procurement team is waiting.

Onward,
Eleanor
